emotional_tone: Warm, personal, beautiful, quiet kindness, calm, slightly magical
target_audience: Physical QR card scanners seeking a quiet, unexpected moment of delight and pause

layout_and_structure.viewport_container: min-h-[100dvh] w-full bg-[#FAF7F0] text-[#3D382F] flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-6 sm:p-10 select-none overflow-x-hidden relative
layout_and_structure.inner_card_wrapper: w-full max-w-md mx-auto my-auto flex flex-col items-center text-center justify-center space-y-8 z-10

screen_0_hero.description: First view scanned from QR code. Pure centered composition with zero distractions.
components: Integrated Brand Mark / Logo (SVG custom curved organic emblem blended into background without card or border)
On-load masked line-by-line text reveal using Framer Motion
Heading (Playfair Display): 'A little something for you.'
Subtitle (DM Sans): 'No reason. No occasion. Just because you're here.'
Primary Action Button: 'Give me a little something →' with gentle warm glow hover and active press state
Small Muted Note: 'Take a tiny pause.'

screen_1_to_5_moments.description: 5-step interactive sequence. One category moment at a time in fixed category order with randomized quote selection per session.
screen_1_to_5_moments.progress_bar: 5 soft dots at the top of the viewport. Active dot expands to pill with smooth background shift.

reminder: You are doing much better than you give yourself credit for.
You don't have to figure out your entire life today.
It is okay to rest without earning it first.
Your quiet efforts are leaving warm ripples you can't even see.
pause: Take one deep breath right now. Drop your shoulders away from your ears.
Unclench your jaw. Relax your forehead. Release your hands.
Close your eyes for 5 seconds and listen to the furthest sound you can hear.
Place one hand on your chest and take two slow, warm breaths.
connection: Think of someone who brought light into your week. Send them a quiet mental thank you.
Somewhere out there, someone remembers a kind word you said years ago.
We are all walking each other home, step by small step.
Reach out to an old friend today just to ask how their heart is doing.
mood_shift: Look out the window or at the nearest doorway. Notice three soft colors.
Gently roll your ankles and wrists. Feel the physical space you occupy right now.
Imagine setting down a heavy backpack you've been carrying all week.
Smile quietly to yourself for no reason other than being right here.
silly: Did you know sea otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart?
A group of pugs is called a 'grumble'. Now you live with this knowledge.
Cows have best friends and get stressed when they are separated.
Wombat poop is shaped like cubes so it doesn't roll away.

components: Warm Climax Heading: 'That was your little something. 💛'
Subtext: 'Maybe you needed one. Maybe you didn't. Either way, we're glad you stopped by.'
Restart CTA: 'Give me another little something →' (generates a fresh randomized set from content pool)
Slow Editorial Marquee at bottom: 'Where connections begin, stories unfold. • Somewhere Together • Where connections begin, stories unfold.'
Option to share or copy a moment card as a digital note

motion_and_microinteractions.page_transitions: Framer Motion layout animations with opacity 0 -> 1 and subtle y offset (12px -> 0px) with cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)
motion_and_microinteractions.button_interactions: scale 1.02 on hover, scale 0.98 on press, soft shadow glow transition
motion_and_microinteractions.progress_dots_animation: layoutId transition for active step width expansion

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Playfair Display and DM Sans in index.html / index.css.
Ensure background is strictly #FAF7F0 with zero dark mode toggle or SaaS borders.
Implement Framer Motion for line-by-line text reveals and crossfade moment slides.
Ensure exact fixed order for moments: Reminder -> Tiny Pause -> Connection -> Mood Shift -> Something Silly.
Ensure fresh randomized selection on each restart from the moment bank.
Implement the editorial marquee on the ending screen using infinite CSS/framer-motion loop.
Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in testing.required_test_ids are strictly present.
